title: Check the money is there before payday
summary: Every morning, compare the payrolls Payrolla will pay soon with the balance of the account that funds them, and warn the owner if it is short.
description: Every morning, Taskiem looks at the payrolls in Payrolla due in the next few days and compares their net total with the balance of the payments account you fund payroll from. If it is short, it tells the owner and the people you choose how much to top up, in time. It moves no money. Needs Payrolla's Read payroll permission, and a connected payments account that reports its balance (Paystack, Moniepoint, iswallet, Flutterwave or Anchor).

params.name: payrolla_connection
params.title: Payrolla connection
params.description: The Payrolla company this follows: its key, from Payrolla → Settings → Connected apps.

params.name: rail_connection
params.title: Account that funds payroll
params.description: The payments account payroll money comes from: any you connected that reports its balance.

params.name: funding_account
params.title: Wallet to check
params.description: Only for iswallet and Anchor, which hold several wallets: the one payroll comes from. Leave it blank otherwise.

params.name: days_before
params.title: Days ahead
params.description: How many days before payday to start checking.

params.name: check_time
params.title: Time
params.description: When the check runs each day, Lagos time.

params.name: notify_role
params.title: Who else is told
params.description: Besides the owner, the role told when money is short.

definition.name: Check the money is there before payday

output.total_kobo: =sum((has(steps.runs.output.runs) ? steps.runs.output.runs : []).filter(r, timestamp(r.pay_date + 'T23:59:59Z') - timestamp(has(trigger.scheduled_time) ? trigger.scheduled_time : run.started_at) <= duration(string({{days_before}} * 24) + 'h')).map(r, r.total_net_kobo))
output.count: =size((has(steps.runs.output.runs) ? steps.runs.output.runs : []).filter(r, timestamp(r.pay_date + 'T23:59:59Z') - timestamp(has(trigger.scheduled_time) ? trigger.scheduled_time : run.started_at) <= duration(string({{days_before}} * 24) + 'h')))

input.title: Payroll money is short
input.message: ='Payroll due soon needs NGN ' + string(steps.due.output.total_kobo / 100) + ', but the account holds NGN ' + string(steps.balance.output.available_kobo / 100) + '. Top up NGN ' + string((steps.due.output.total_kobo - steps.balance.output.available_kobo) / 100) + ' before payday.'
